input: Find a local tai chi instructor for beginners

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the user's city or neighborhood determines which instructors and venues are actually reachable for them.
Whether this is for the user alone, a child, an elderly parent, or a group changes the type of instructor and class format needed.
Preferred days and times directly filter which classes the user can attend, ruling out many otherwise suitable options.
A budget limit for lessons (per session or per month) determines whether private instruction, group classes, or community center programs are realistic.
The user's specific goal (stress relief, fitness, martial arts, balance for seniors) shapes which style of tai chi and instructor background is most appropriate.
Whether the user wants in-person classes, online sessions, or is open to both affects the entire search strategy.
Knowing what a good outcome looks like — e.g., a single trial class booked, a committed weekly schedule, or a shortlist of vetted instructors — defines when the task is actually done.

gold.taskTitle: Find a local tai chi instructor for beginners
gold.taskDescription: Identify and connect with a nearby tai chi instructor who teaches beginner-level classes.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you searching in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to scope the search to genuinely nearby instructors and studios.

questions.title: Who will be taking the tai chi classes?
questions.description: Determine whether the classes are for the user, a child, an older adult, or a group, as this changes the instructor type and class format required.

questions.title: Which days and times are you available each week?
questions.description: Establish scheduling availability to filter out classes the user cannot realistically attend.

questions.title: What is your budget per class or per month?
questions.description: Understand the financial constraint to recommend private lessons, group classes, or low-cost community center programs accordingly.

questions.title: What is your main goal for learning tai chi?
questions.description: Clarify the primary motivation — such as stress relief, general fitness, fall prevention, or martial arts — to match the user with the right style and instructor background.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person classes or are you open to online?
questions.description: Determine the format preference to decide whether to search only local venues or also consider virtual instruction.

questions.title: What does success look like — a shortlist, or a class booked?
questions.description: Establish the desired end state to know when the task is truly complete, whether that is a curated list of options or a confirmed first session.
